edits.why: maude-v2 callouts have no info tone; a plain (quiet) callout carries the Get-latest nudge, and the pulsing info dot stays.
maude-v2 has no warn callout; its heads-up tone (specimen .co--heads) is the callout on --bg-3. That tone isn't in the shared classes, so the background is set here.

notes: Locked, left as is: the Changes tab (data-cd-id="changes", data-cd-locked). maude-v2 has no .tabbar/.tab, so the Changes/History tabs will show as plain buttons until they move to .seg (with aria-pressed). The History tab is left as is too, so the two match. To restyle them, unlock the Changes tab (⇧⌘L) and ask again.
Theme: the proposal sets data-theme="light" (maude-v2's default). To keep the canvas dark, use data-theme="dark" in the Board edit and drop the header edit.

GitPanel.css isn't part of these edits. Every token it uses exists in maude-v2, so it renders without changes. Follow-ups worth doing there: (1) .gp-badge uses color: var(--bg-0) on the status fills. In light, --bg-0 is near-white, so the M badge on --status-warn fails contrast. Use --status-warn-fg / --status-success-fg / --status-error-fg. (2) maude-v2 keeps mono for Advanced and code only. .gp-context, .gp-tree-hd, .gp-group-hd, .gp-sect-label, .gp-count, .gp-avatar, .gp-badge, .gp-file-path, .gp-version-meta, .gp-version-when and .gp-stage-tag all use --font-mono. (3) .gp-mark-spark uses --accent (azure). In maude-v2 the spark is the brand/AI vermilion (--spark). (4) The menubar, tree and panel are flat docked chrome. maude-v2 floats chrome as islands (--island-bg, --island-shadow, soft radii), which would be a redesign, not a switch.
Brand: the drawn spark-on-bubble mark is maude's. maude-v2 ships system/maude-v2/assets/logos/mark.svg and wordmark.svg. Swapping them in is a brand decision.

ds-check suggests dropping the two CSS imports, since the shell injects the system. The proposal keeps them, pointed at maude-v2, so the canvas renders the same whichever system the host injects (the reason given in the canvas's own header comment).
Alias tokens (--accent-muted, --accent-tint, --canvas-*) still resolve in maude-v2, so no edit is needed.
